builds.type: Noto Sans sans; bold display heading, regular body
builds.layout: long-scroll alternating sections; 3-column product card grid; 4-up application grid
builds.engine: Canvas 2D airflow particles (yellow/grey streaks + dots, mouse proximity brighten, reduced-motion static)
builds.material: restrained industrial machined-metal feel; no emoji icons; hairline borders + tinted shadows

builds.motivation: B2B manufacturer page: fast scan, discover products, a sense of exploration while browsing
builds.layout: VR vane series becomes a desktop sticky horizontal rail: sticky viewport crops, inner track translates on scroll; progress bar + 01/07 counter; staggered tile heights, bottom aligned
builds.disclosure: Spec line (speed/power) hidden by default on hover-capable pointer devices, fades in on card hover; always visible on touch / reduced-motion
builds.navigation: Section spy via IntersectionObserver at 45% mid-line; nav link highlights current section, anchors jump
builds.fallback: Width <=960px or prefers-reduced-motion: rail degrades to vertical stack, counter/progress hidden; no WebGL/3D/exploded view (product photos are整泵白底图, deferred)
builds.notes: Transform target is the inner track, NOT the sticky viewport (sticky position cancels a transform on the sticky element itself)
